description: Credentials and schedule for the Qonto transaction sync.

fields.description: When switched on, new Qonto transactions are fetched every hour. Leave it off while you are still setting things up, and switch it off any time you want to pause imports - your credentials stay saved.
fields.label: Import transactions automatically

fields.description: In the Qonto app: Settings → Integrations and Partnerships → API key. Qonto shows a login and a secret key - copy both into the fields here.
fields.label: API Login

fields.description: Stored encrypted. It is not shown again after saving and never appears in logs.
fields.label: API Secret Key

fields.description: For trying things out against Qonto's sandbox instead of your real account. Leave this off for normal use.
fields.label: Use Qonto's test environment

fields.description: Only needed for the sandbox. You get it from Qonto's developer portal.
fields.label: Test environment token

fields.description: The very first import starts at this date. After that, each run continues where the previous one stopped. Choose the beginning of the period you still need to reconcile.
fields.label: Import transactions from

fields.description: Only used when linking. If a Qonto account has no bank account in ERPNext yet, a new one is created for this company. Bank accounts that already exist keep the company they have.
fields.label: Company for new bank accounts
